fact: 帝国境内的外国人依据治外法权条约体系（Capitulations，投降制度）自成法律单元，“被置于单独地位，依照自己的法律与习俗自我治理”；宗教社区（millet）制度同样把居民按信仰分治。1907年的任何商业与身份安排都必须嵌入这套双重分治结构。

sources.title: Clair Price, The Rebirth of Turkey (New York: George H. Doran Company, 1923), Project Gutenberg eBook #65436
sources.quote: Even foreigners were likewise set apart under the Capitulations and were permitted to govern themselves under their own laws and customs.

fact: 阿卜杜勒·哈米德二世的统治依赖一套自Yıldız（耶尔德兹）宫辐射的间谍网络：它无法把西方思想挡在首都之外，却能将其压入地下；这套监控使军队获得“双重存在”——表面维持东方军事传统，暗中成为西方思想与秘密结社的温床（俄国虚无主义的示范加剧了秘密社团潮）。

sources.title: Clair Price, The Rebirth of Turkey (New York: George H. Doran Company, 1923), Project Gutenberg eBook #65436
sources.quote: Having heard of the French Revolution, a system of espionage which could not keep Western ideas out of the capital but which could, and did, keep them underground. The military tradition of the country continued to attract its best brains into the Army but the network of espionage which radiated from Yildiz Kiosk had the effect of giving the Army a sort of dual existence. On the surface, it continued to be a military organism, the trustee of an Eastern military tradition, but beneath the surface it became a ferment of forbidden Western ideas and the example of Nihilism in Russia which did much to spread the secret society craze, found no more fertile element to work upon than the yeasty mentality of the War Academy and the Military College

fact: 青年土耳其党的地下组织在1907年已高度成熟：Ahmed Riza Bey领导的巴黎流亡者团体从巴黎蒙日广场（Place Monge）的公寓向帝国各地兵营走私革命刊物《协商》（Mechveret）；Enver、Niazi、Mustafa Kemal等人在军队中建立秘密网络，“在每个兵营都有代理人，策动军官与士兵，并刺杀被视为间谍的敌对军官与士兵”，目标是迫使苏丹恢复宪法。萨洛尼卡（Salonica）是网络的国内枢纽。

sources.title: Clair Price, The Rebirth of Turkey (New York: George H. Doran Company, 1923), Project Gutenberg eBook #65436
sources.quote: A little group of Ottoman exiles in Paris of whom Ahmed Riza Bey was the leader, had discovered the formula which was to achieve that internal unity which the Empire had long enjoyed... This was the ideal which Riza Bey lifted up in the little revolutionary periodical Mechveret which was smuggled into every garrison in the Empire from his little flat in the Place Monge, near the Montmarte section of Paris. This was the ideal which young Turks like Enver and Niazi and Kemal were propagating, as they built up the secret organization which was to compel Abdul Hamid to restore the Constitution. Throughout the Empire, they had their agents in every garrison, converting both the officers and the enlisted personnel of Abdul Hamid's Army, and assassinating hostile officers and men known to be spies.

fact: 秘密活动的代价有个人化样本：Mustafa Kemal因信任之人实为阿卜杜勒·哈米德的间谍而被捕，在Yıldız宫受审后关押警察牢房三个月，1902年底被流放到大马士革骑兵部队；他在当地立即与来自军事学院的流亡者建立新的秘密组织分支。1907年的地下网络参与者随时面临逮捕-审讯-流放链条。

sources.title: Clair Price, The Rebirth of Turkey (New York: George H. Doran Company, 1923), Project Gutenberg eBook #65436
sources.quote: an acquaintance whom he trusted and whom he permitted to sleep in the apartment at night on the plea that he was penniless, proved to be one of Abdul Hamid's spies and Kemal was arrested. Having been questioned at Yildiz Kiosk, he was held for three months in a police cell and then exiled late in 1902 to a cavalry regiment in Damascus.

fact: 德资铁路特许体系在1907年前已深入帝国：1888年奥斯曼政府把海达尔帕夏（Haidar Pasha）至伊兹米特（Ismid）的56英里铁路转让给柏林德意志银行组织的辛迪加，并附带经埃斯基谢希尔（Eski-Shehr）东延约300英里至安卡拉（Angora）的特许；该项目由德国集团“奥斯曼安纳托利亚铁路公司”执行，随后又获得延至凯撒利亚（Caesarea）的230英里延伸特许，并继续向锡瓦斯、迪亚巴克尔、摩苏尔方向推进。

sources.title: Clair Price, The Rebirth of Turkey (New York: George H. Doran Company, 1923), Project Gutenberg eBook #65436
sources.quote: In 1888, the Ottoman Government transferred to a syndicate formed by the Deutsche Bank of Berlin a 56-mile railway from Haidar Pasha, a suburb of Constantinople, to Ismid on the Sea of Marmora, and accompanied the transfer with a concession to extend the line some 300 miles due east via Eski-Shehr to Angora. ... This concession was utilized by a German group calling itself the Ottoman Anatolian Railway Company, which soon received a further concession for the construction of a 230-mile extension of the Angora line to Caesarea.

fact: 1908年7月23日晨，青年土耳其革命爆发：萨洛尼卡第三军在Mahmoud Shevket Pasha率领下（年轻时的Kemal任其参谋长）向君士坦丁堡进军，不到一周议会即被恢复；四名议员（两土耳其人、一基督徒、一犹太人）向阿卜杜勒·哈米德提出退位要求，这位“东方主义者的最后代表”离开Yıldız宫，被囚于萨洛尼卡，穆罕默德五世继位，权力核心转为萨洛尼卡总部的统一与进步委员会（CUP）。

sources.title: Clair Price, The Rebirth of Turkey (New York: George H. Doran Company, 1923), Project Gutenberg eBook #65436
sources.quote: Mahmoud Shevket Pasha, with the young Kemal as his Chief of Staff, immediately marched on Constantinople with the Third Army from Salonica, and in less than a week the Parliament was restored. Four of its deputies――two Turks, a Christian and a Jew――presented themselves before Abdul Hamid with the demand of the Young Turks for his abdication. The last of the out-and-out Easterners left Yildiz Kiosk to spend the remainder of his days in a Salonica dungeon, and Mohammed V succeeded him with the Young Turkish Parliament as the seat of authority in his Government. And the seat of authority in the Young Turkish Parliament was the Committee of Union and Progress, which ruled the capital from its headquarters at Salonica.

fact: 1907年英俄协定与帝国命运的时间关联：Price认为英俄协定（1907）“紧接着就是1908年的青年土耳其革命”；协定中对波斯的瓜分与对阿富汗的让渡重塑了帝国周边的大国均势，君士坦丁堡的改革派判断列强注意力将转向欧洲对德矛盾，宪政冒险的外部约束随之松动。

sources.title: Clair Price, The Rebirth of Turkey (New York: George H. Doran Company, 1923), Project Gutenberg eBook #65436
sources.quote: The Anglo-Russian Treaty of 1907 was quickly followed by the Young Turkish Revolution of 1908. Turks and Armenians alike rejoiced at the downfall of the Hamidian regime.
